summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency source enables install-time code execution
details: package.json declares the dependency `libsignal` with source `github:pernapasquale647-dotcom/paki-libsignal` — a bare GitHub owner/repo reference with no commit SHA, tag, or version pin. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever the default branch HEAD contains at install time and runs any lifecycle scripts inside that repository. The referenced GitHub account is author-controlled and the reference is mutable after this package is published, so the contents fetched and executed on the installer's machine can be changed at any time without any corresponding publish of @akapaki/baileys.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
